[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The index names Elizth Jane Macgregor and John Bowling Glasgow marrying at Sydney in 1873, registration 374. The marriage record is the held record naming her before the children's births, which call her Elizabeth Jane Glasgow.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1780/records/1764825 Ancestry, Australia, Marriage Index, 1788–1950: John Bowling Glasgow and Elizth Jane Macgregor, record 1780/1764825].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The 1873 Sydney marriage identifies a later John Bowling Glasgow household. Birth indexes name John Bowling or John B Glasgow and Elizabeth Jane as parents of Blanche Ellen (1874), John William (1877), Ernest Bowling (1879), Alexander James (1882) and Eva E (1886) in Sydney. The shared names, district and chronology support one family; the parent identity remains probable rather than proved by a single record. No later death or parentage record is held.
